user.title: Create appliance
user.description: Choose an appliance type. For a physical appliance, select its metering device.

sensors.title: Select appliance sensors
sensors.description: Check the selected sensors. Choose Energy manually when several counters are available. Clear an optional field to leave it unassigned.

aggregate.title: Custom Total membership
aggregate.description: Select appliances to combine. Changing members changes the displayed totals.

error.energy_in_use: This energy sensor is already assigned to another appliance.
error.logical_sensor: Select a physical sensor from another integration.
error.unknown_device: Select a device that is still in the Home Assistant device registry.
error.not_device_sensor: Select a compatible sensor belonging to the selected metering device.
error.invalid_member: Select existing physical Appliance Meter appliances only; remove missing or aggregate members.
error.logical_device: Select a physical metering device from another integration, not an Appliance Meter virtual device.

init.title: Edit appliance
init.description: Clear an optional field to remove its assignment.
